name: @oxyhq/app-preset
description: The Oxy distro of Expo — centralized Expo config plugin, Metro/Babel/ESLint factories, Tailwind base CSS and TypeScript bases shared by every Oxy app (Mention, Homiio, Allo, accounts, …). A zero-build package: apps replace copy-pasted config with a single dependency bump.
author: OxyHQ
//peerDependencies: THE CAPS ON THE TWO @oxyhq PEERS ARE DELIBERATE, AND RE-RAISING ONE MEANS RE-CHECKING THE PATH IT GUARDS, NOT JUST THE NUMBER. This package couples to those two by FILE PATH, not by API: `css/base.css` imports `@oxyhq/bloom/design-tokens/theme.css`, and `plugin/withOxyAppPreset.js` optionally requires `@oxyhq/services/plugins/withSharedIdentityReader`. Both paths were verified present across the whole floor-to-cap range, so the floors are measured rather than guessed. They were previously `*`, which is not a range but the absence of one -- and an unbounded peer on a package that ships breaking majors is exactly what let a consumer install @oxyhq/services with an @oxyhq/bloom it could not work with, silently. When @oxyhq/services 31 or @oxyhq/bloom 2 ships, confirm the two subpaths above still resolve in the new major BEFORE widening the cap; a cap widened without that check is worse than no cap, because it looks like someone checked.
